harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: On node1 (AlmaLinux 9), built a local RPM repository at /srv/local-repo from packages pre-downloaded while the network was up (tree-1.8.0-10.el9.x86_64.rpm + createrepo_c metadata), registered it via /etc/yum.repos.d/local-file.repo (file:// baseurl, gpgcheck=0). Simulated the usual remote repos being unreachable by disabling all almalinux-*.repo files and adding iptables REJECT rules on tcp/80 and tcp/443, confirmed via curl and dnf that remotes were unreachable, then installed `tree` successfully using only the local-file repo. Reverted the firewall rules and re-enabled the original remote repos, verified remote reachability restored. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured boot_id baseline (513c865e...), rebooted node1 via `shutdown -r now` (ack returned before disconnect), polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id (bcd7d486...), and verified post-restart that tree remained installed, local repo storage/metadata were intact, remote repos were enabled/reachable again, and no leftover firewall rules remained.
actions_performed: Captured baseline OS/repo/network state on node1
Installed createrepo_c and dnf-plugins-core
Downloaded tree-1.8.0-10.el9.x86_64.rpm into /srv/local-repo while network was reachable
Ran createrepo_c to build repo metadata
Created /etc/yum.repos.d/local-file.repo pointing to file:///srv/local-repo
Disabled all almalinux-*.repo remote repos (backed up originals to /root/repo-backup)
Added iptables REJECT rules for tcp/80 and tcp/443 to make remote repos genuinely unreachable
Confirmed remote unreachability via curl and dnf repolist
Installed tree package using only the local-file repo (--disablerepo=* --enablerepo=local-file)
Verified installation via rpm -q, which, tree --version
Removed iptables REJECT rules
Restored original almalinux-*.repo files (enabled=1)
Confirmed remote reachability restored
Captured pre-restart boot_id and health baseline
Rebooted node1 via sudo shutdown -r now with backgrounded ack
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again
Verified boot_id changed post-restart
Verified tree package, local repo storage/metadata, remote repo config, and firewall state all recovered post-restart

evidence.requirement: Local package repository served from local storage with correct metadata
evidence.summary: createrepo_c built repodata in /srv/local-repo; dnf --disablerepo=* --enablerepo=local-file repolist/list confirmed the local repo is readable and lists tree as available
All almalinux-*.repo files disabled and iptables REJECT rules added for tcp/80,443; curl to mirrors.almalinux.org confirmed CONFIRMED-UNREACHABLE

evidence.requirement: Package installed from the local repo while remote repos unreachable
evidence.summary: dnf install -y --disablerepo=* --enablerepo=local-file tree succeeded, installing tree-1.8.0-10.el9.x86_64 from the local-file repo; rpm -q tree and tree --version confirmed successful install

evidence.requirement: Environment restored to normal (remote repos re-enabled, firewall reverted)
evidence.summary: iptables REJECT rules removed (verified no rules remain), original repo files restored with enabled=1, curl confirmed remote reachability restored
Captured boot_id 513c865e-e121-4025-a0a4-8689cc580398, systemctl is-system-running=running, rpm -q tree installed, local repo files present, local-file.repo config present

evidence.requirement: Node restart acknowledgement returns before disconnect
evidence.summary: sudo shutdown -r now backgrounded with nohup; exec call returned 'reboot-triggered' successfully before the node went down

evidence.requirement: Node actually restarted (connection drop + changed boot identity)
evidence.summary: Immediate follow-up exec timed out (node down mid-reboot); subsequent poll succeeded with boot_id bcd7d486-a587-48b5-92c7-49a9498c3e29, proving a genuine reboot occurred (changed from 513c865e...)

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required services/data verified
evidence.summary: systemctl is-system-running=running; rpm -q tree still installed; /srv/local-repo and repodata intact; local-file.repo config intact; remote almalinux-baseos/appstream repos re-enabled and listed by dnf repolist; no leftover iptables 80/443 rules
